name: Isometric flow
description: A miniature 3D process: an immediate opening, a van that triggers each step, and a delivery arrival with a building punch and a pulse back along the road.

name: Blue editorial
description: An ultramarine editorial cover with frame-filling italic words, a kicker snap, a slanted reveal and four strips striking into an oversized final word.

name: Ink Wash
description: Large upright lettering and a mottled red sun open on rice paper. Mountain washes bend beneath clear title silhouettes. A rower crosses into open water, draws a trailing wake and completes an oar stroke as the pine finishes. A small, eroded red seal stamps last.

name: Hours collapse
description: Equal calendar hours land from the bottom up. The mascot gulps, crouches and stomps each labelled hour into a sliver as a clock rewinds. The final time slams above a bright terracotta block.

name: Agent fan-out
description: A prompt opens inside a branching burst. Colourful agents work and finish separately, then attached branches pull them into one pile. The last tick, full count and green result slab land together.

name: App launch
description: A broad studio phone receives a transaction. Its camera pill and percentage chip become readable cards, then clear for a much larger transfer payoff with an exact amount and solid accent-colour finish.
